personality_one_liner: A visual-first digital scrapbook where one photo and one mood capture the essence of your day with joyful warmth.

spacing.rule: Generous organic padding and rounded stacking, keeping primary CTAs accessible in the thumb zone.

do's: Layer cards like physical paper scrapbook elements
Apply soft terracotta and peach borders
dont's: Do not use cold glass blurs or dark futuristic styling

screens.name: Today
screens.purpose: Showcases today's captured moment with mood badge, thoughts, and quick capture trigger.

states.loading: Centered warm spinner with scrapbook greeting
states.empty: Polaroid placeholder with 'Capture today's memory' prompt and bouncy primary button

screens.layout: Sticky top date header with streak counter pill, followed by today's large hero Polaroid card with photo and mood stamp, interactive song/thought capsule, and quick reaction buttons.

screens.name: Capture
screens.purpose: Lightning-fast 30-second daily moment capture: photo + mood + optional thought.

states.empty: Camera access permission prompt with clear friendly explanation
states.error: Camera error state with fallback image picker option

screens.layout: Full-bleed live camera viewfinder or photo picker dropzone, floating mood selection pill strip at the bottom, and a prominent round capture shutter button.

screens.name: Journal
screens.purpose: A rich chronological scrapbook grid and calendar archive of all past moments.

states.empty: Empty bookshelf illustration with 'Your story starts today' caption and start capture CTA
states.error: Error loading archive with retry action

screens.layout: Search and filter header by mood/month, followed by a staggered two-column masonry scrapbook grid of past memory cards with taped corners and handwritten caption fonts.

screens.name: Mood
screens.purpose: Emotional visualization and Spotify-Wrapped style mood breakdown of your life.

states.empty: Prompt to log at least 3 days of moods to generate your emotional aura
states.error: Unable to load aura visualization with retry button

screens.layout: Top monthly mood aura flower/gradient card, followed by frequency breakdown bars, emotional word clouds, and reflection cards.

screens.name: Me
screens.purpose: Personal settings, streak stats, privacy defaults, and data export options.

states.empty: Guest profile card with sign in prompt
states.error: Failed to load profile data with refresh action

screens.layout: Profile header with avatar and streak stats, followed by categorized settings rows (Privacy, Reminders, Export Data, About LITTLE) with tinted icon containers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the app using Personality 4 (Tactile / Playful LIGHT) with a warm cream (#FFFDF9) base and coral/peach/sunny yellow accents.
Ensure all fonts use Outfit for headings and Plus Jakarta Sans for body text, keeping all weights at 400 or 500 max.
Implement the 5 bottom tabs: Today, Capture, Journal, Mood, Me with the Capture tab visually standing out as the hero action.
Every screen must support loading, empty, and error states fully.
Ensure all touch targets are >= 44x44pt and safe area is respected at screen roots.
Never use banned colors like navy, indigo, violet, or purple; stick to warm earth and soft pastel tones.
Do not use emojis in system UI; use Ionicons for all interface icons.
